direction: Two representations and faithfulness; counterexample-guided reverse learning with switch and swap
question: Do direct unreduced Burau matrices agree with abelianized Fox derivatives of independently computed Artin actions on a bounded braid-word family? Can a finite backward search refine a t=1 collision into a checked separating jet, while basis swaps alone retain the collision?
level: External exact algebra and bounded representation calibration, not a proof of the new B4 theorem, native Adva faithfulness, or geometric arc realizability
imports: Artin generators acting by x_i -> x_i x_(i+1) x_i^-1 and x_(i+1) -> x_i, with explicitly specified inverse
Unreduced Burau positive block [[1-t,t],[1,0]] and its exact inverse
Fox differentiation and common exponent-sum abelianization
Finite Taylor coefficients at t=1 via integer binomial coefficients
The published B4 claim is background only and is not an oracle for the run
convention: Appending generator g means substituting its Artin map into each current free-group image; row Fox Jacobians therefore multiply on the right by the displayed generator matrix

families.words: All words of length 0 through 4 with no adjacent inverse pair; no other words discarded and no adaptive enlargement
families.swaps: All 24 simultaneous row/column basis permutations at jet order zero for each reverse pair
families.relations: Generator/inverse, adjacent braid relations, and distant commutations for n=3,4
families.boundary_polynomial: (t-1)^9 has zero jet through order eight but is nonzero outside the declared degree window

checker: Direct sparse Laurent matrix multiplication is compared with free-word substitution plus prefix-sum Fox coefficients. Integer jet expansion is checked by exact inverse reconstruction for the bounded degree window. Every word, free-group image, matrix and reverse-search failure/witness is retained. Shared integer operations, runtime and conventions remain trusted.
protected: Raw words and source positions are retained even when their represented braid actions coincide
Basis conjugacy does not change a representation kernel
Moving from a specialized matrix to a richer jet requires the retained source or a validated lift
Kernel exclusion needs a nonzero separating witness; lack of one within budget is Unknown or an explicitly scoped equality
General Adva weak observation does not lift to a strong objectification cell
Finite word checks do not prove unbounded B4 faithfulness
No physical energy, native dual, or geometry catalog admission is inferred
exit: One frozen run; PassedFiniteCalibration, ImplementationFailure, or Unknown on limit. No restart or native operation. Preserve completed rows and all failed observer attempts.
cost_scope: Charge scalar polynomial products, substitutions, coefficient checks, search candidates and serialization chunks. Process CPU, wall, memory and output are bounded including checkpointing. Research, implementation authoring and remote publication are excluded. Hard termination may prevent a final checkpoint.
open: A native occurrence/cell observer family realizing this principle on K1-K5
Geometric certification of the paper's disk, parity and point-pushing constructions
Useful endogenous observer generation outside the frozen jet ladder
General faithfulness, fullness and strong objectification
